concepts.title: 01 / Warm Clarity
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished, high-resolution Android UI design concept board for SAFAR Exam Planner. This is a visual mockup for user selection, NOT a marketing poster. Show SIX complete app screen canvases in a clean THREE COLUMN by TWO ROW layout. Top row: Exams, Today, Syllabus. Bottom row: Calendar, Progress, Plan setup. Screen canvases are the actual rectangular UI views, WITHOUT phone/device frames, status bars, browser chrome, perspective, hands or photographic desk. Thin gutters and a restrained concept title outside the canvases. Prioritize readable, correctly spelled English, realistic Compose-implementable controls, complete screens with comfortable spacing. All six views belong to one coherent design system.
All numbers are visibly labeled SAMPLE DATA in a discreet board caption. Common demo content: exam SSC CGL, exam date 18 Dec 2026, current date Fri 23 Oct 2026, 56 days left, today's tasks 2 of 6 done, overall syllabus 42%. Existing primary navigation exactly: Exams, Today, Syllabus, Calendar, Progress. Every bottom bar has all five concise labels and icons, selected item appropriate to its screen. Small black butterfly with pink accents (Titli guide icon) in app top action area, alongside settings or overflow, not an illustrated mascot occupying content.
EXAMS: heading My exams, active SSC CGL card with date, progress and Continue studying action, New exam plan button; secondary Railways exam; Saved syllabi 2; compact Study tools row Parmar tracker and GK5, not large advertisements.
TODAY: compact SSC CGL selector and Plan settings action, heading Today, Fri 23 Oct; 2 of 6 done summary; compact links Revision 3 due and Missed 2; actual task rows high on page: Percentage / Maths with a visible Focus button, Coding / Reasoning with Focus, Tenses / English checked done. Visible add topic action, Daily routine 1 of 3 expandable row, View completed link. Completion targets and action buttons easy to hit. Avoid giant progress ring before task list.
SYLLABUS: SSC CGL context, heading Syllabus, Search topics field, 42% overall, labeled Add subject and Organize actions. Subject rows Maths 48%, Reasoning 61%, English 40%, General Awareness 22%, Computer 15%, Current Affairs 35%, each with counts and a small clear progress bar plus chevron; All 6 subjects visible or clearly indicated. Show a restrained Change plan action.
CALENDAR: heading Calendar, October 2026, Today button, correct weekday labels M T W T F S S and a believable month grid. Oct 1 is Thursday and 23 is Friday. Each relevant date has a tiny workload bar or count, rest-day marker differentiated; selected23. Small text legend Planned, Done, Rest. Below grid: Fri 23 Oct agenda with Percentage / Maths and Coding / Reasoning, visible Change date or Open topic. Compact Revision link.
PROGRESS: SSC CGL context, heading Progress, first card asks Am I on track? with an existing-demo forecast 12 Dec and exam18 Dec; positive status On track. Then 42% syllabus progress, pace and consistency summary, all six subject bars or a four-row preview explicitly labeled View all 6 subjects. Revision summary and Focus time below. Chart labels readable, no meaningless decorative rings.
PLAN SETUP: title Create exam plan, visible phases Syllabus > Study routine > Review, Study routine selected. Exam date18 Dec, Topics per day6, selectable rest days, study styles Deep Focus / Balanced / Mixed Bag as selectable cards. Balanced selected with separate Customize order action. Bottom Review plan action. No surprise navigation indicated just by selecting.
Preserve the same underlying features across all screens; design these as a unified scalable UI template. Use Hanken Grotesk-like modern humanist sans for body/navigation. Heading, body, metadata hierarchy visibly clear; no illegibly tiny text, no repeated enormous hero numbers, no glass blur or busy graphics behind data.
Visual direction: closest to the user's approved Soft Geometry tutorial design. Warm blush canvas #FFF5F0, white #FFFDFC spacious rounded cards, deep plum ink #39132E and plum action fill #542347, peach icon tiles #FFCBBE, mint completion #C9EFE0, restrained coral/yellow/lilac small geometric accents only in header corners. Large rounded 24dp cards, softly rounded pills, open friendly yet professional student productivity app. Structure: selected exam as a compact peach context pill, clear header, rounded content sections; on Today use individual white task cards with visible plum Focus pills. On Progress use one compact mint forecast banner then clear horizontal bars. Header typography bold sans; one restrained EB Garamond-style number accent optional. Color status green done / amber revision / red missed; keep text contrast high. Board title exactly "01 / Warm Clarity".
concepts.refinement: Refine this existing six-screen Warm Clarity UI concept board. Change ONLY the top-left My exams screen: add a clearly visible compact plum button labeled '+ New plan' aligned to the right of the 'My exams' heading, adjusting that heading slightly if necessary to fit the button. This essential creation entry is currently missing. Preserve all other text, all other screens, colors, screen sizes, complete six-screen composition and design quality exactly. No other redesign.

Do not change the grid, dates, typography, other panels, rest of palette, layout, six-screen composition, text, or existing controls.
